source_copy_note: The compatibility runner did not freeze the source before the shared working file advanced; the exact native binary, complete logs, and source identity are preserved.
diagnosis: The dynamic target used an omniscient best terminal action over candidate labels. In these worlds one candidate was usually already the truth, so recursive_best did not exceed terminal_best and beneficial initiation collapsed to zero.
With mostly non-positive continuation targets, all four linear continuation policies converged to the same short stopping behavior despite different feature masks.
The first snapshot also had arm-specific initiation models, confounding entry selection with completion; the next candidate uses one shared initiation model and common initiation features.

The logical warrant predicate was too strict for the produced terminal paths and correctly remained zero; it must be repaired from actual target, provenance, consequence, and parent evidence rather than replaced with a constant.
